name: zero-point energy

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Planck scale UV cutoff and the macroscopic boundary conditions (e.g., Casimir plates) that contain and quantize the field.

VINIT.justification: The initial void state before quantum fluctuations or boundary conditions are applied.

TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor that confines the quantum field, restricting allowed modes and closing the system.

AFWD.justification: The forward-time morphism of the virtual particle along the positive-frequency T-arm.

AREV.justification: The reverse-time (or negative-frequency) morphism of the virtual antiparticle along the F-arm.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of infinite virtual creation/annihilation cycles that compose the zero-point field.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the vacuum state, where the Hamiltonian acting on |0⟩ yields the fixed zero-point energy E₀.

FSPLIT.justification: The vacuum fluctuates, splitting the bare vacuum into a virtual particle-antiparticle pair (or positive/negative frequency modes).

FFUSE.justification: The virtual particle and antiparticle annihilate, reconstituting the exact bare vacuum state.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative evaluation where the fluctuation mode satisfies the boundary conditions and constructively interferes.

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation where the fluctuation mode violates boundary conditions and is destructively excluded.

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice: the vacuum is held simultaneously as completely empty of real particles and entirely full of virtual fluctuations.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible, permanent macroscopic record of zero-point energy, measured as a physical force or spectral shift.

phase_3.void_description: The classical empty vacuum, devoid of quantum fields, fluctuations, or boundary constraints.
phase_3.true_description: An allowed virtual fluctuation mode that satisfies boundary conditions and constructively interferes.
phase_3.false_description: A suppressed or forbidden mode excluded by boundary conditions via destructive interference.
phase_3.both_description: The quantum vacuum itself — simultaneously empty of real particles and full of virtual fluctuations.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the bare classical vacuum state |0⟩ before any quantum fluctuations.
Impose boundary conditions (e.g., Casimir plates) or UV cutoff to contain and quantize the field.
The vacuum fluctuates, splitting the bare vacuum into a virtual particle-antiparticle pair.
The virtual particle propagates forward in time along the T-arm.
The fluctuation mode is allowed by the boundary conditions (constructive interference).
The virtual antiparticle propagates backward in time along the F-arm.
The fluctuation mode is excluded by the boundary conditions (destructive interference).
The virtual pair annihilates, reconstituting the original bare vacuum state.
The vacuum is held as a paradice: simultaneously empty of real particles and full of virtual fluctuations.
Chain these continuous virtual fluctuations over time to form the persistent zero-point field.
The ground state self-recognizes its fixed zero-point energy eigenvalue (H|0⟩ = E₀|0⟩).
The macroscopic manifestation (e.g., Casimir force or Lamb shift) is permanently recorded as a measurable physical effect.
The terminal boundary closes the quantized field system, containing the zero-point energy.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Quantum field theory Lagrangian and path integral measure
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Commutators and propagators mediating field interactions and mode exclusions
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The vacuum state vector and Fock space occupation numbers
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Hamiltonian operator dictating time evolution and energy eigenvalues
phase_5.alfs_store: The Planck scale cutoff and fundamental constants (ℏ, c)

phase_6.cycle_cost: Zero net energy exchange; fluctuations borrow energy ΔE for time Δt ≤ ℏ/2ΔE
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Bare vacuum state before virtual pair creation
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Bare vacuum state after virtual pair annihilation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The virtual pair creation and annihilation is a reversible, unitary process that leaves the macroscopic vacuum entropy unchanged.
